name: Goi ca thoi loi
summary: Gỏi cá thòi lòi trộn lá lìm kìm is a salad of mangrove mudskipper and lá lìm kìm. The fish is sweet, fragrant, and soft, against a sour, slightly astringent leaf.
howToEat: Pick young lá lìm kìm, take off the stems, wash, and drain. The leaf is sour and a little astringent, so the sauce is a bit sweet. Mix nước mắm with tomato, pour it on the leaves, and add fried shallot and chili.
Dân Việt says the salad is better with rượu mật ong rừng Sác. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Goi ca thoi loi — mudskipper salad in Can Gio
seoDescription: Gỏi cá thòi lòi trộn lá lìm kìm is a mudskipper salad. The fish is sweet, fragrant, and soft against a sour leaf.
culture: Dân Việt calls it a homestyle plate and pairs it with rượu mật ong rừng Sác.
texture: The fish is sweet, fragrant, and soft. The leaf is sour and a little astringent.
taste: Sour and astringent leaf, sweet fish sauce with sugar, fried shallot, and chili.
